articles.title: Trump diz que Filipinas deixarão de comprar produtos agrícolas do Brasil
articles.en: Trump says the Philippines will stop buying agricultural products from Brazil

articles.title: Zmarł Piotr Moczulski. Dwa lata spędził w szpitalu na Filipinach, MON wysłało po niego samolot
articles.en: Piotr Moczulski has died. He spent two years in a hospital in the Philippines, and the Ministry of National Defence sent a plane for him
